facts.title: asparagus, artichoke and shiitake risotto
ingredients: 1 pound (455 grams) thin to medium asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices, leaving tips 1 1/2 inches long
3/4 pound (340 grams) fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded and caps cut into 1/4 inch thick slices
2 large fresh artichoke hearts, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices, prepared*
1 1/2 cups (10 ounces or 285 grams) Arborio rice
2 ounces finely grated parmesan cheese (about 1/2 cup)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
